# PS Almenpsykiatrisk, Syd Ambulatorier

PS Almenpsykiatrisk, Syd Ambulatorier is a psychiatric outpatient clinic in Region Nordjylland, Denmark, that appears in the ADHD-databasen 2024 report as a facility-level data point for two of the database's quality indicators. Its record is notable chiefly for how starkly different its results look depending on which indicator is being measured.

On Indicator 10 — which tracks whether adult patients' social support needs were assessed within 120 days of treatment start — the clinic scored 0% fulfillment, based on a very limited dataset of just 20 treatment courses (0/20) [^src2]. This sits within a national picture that the report itself describes as troubling: nationally only 37% of cases met the 90% quality target for this indicator, with regional results ranging from 14% to 52%, and this was the first time the indicator had ever been reported. The steering group behind the database specifically discussed registration practices and data quality — particularly from child and adolescent psychiatric outpatient clinics and private hospitals — as likely explanations for such low scores, rather than assuming they reflect actual clinical shortfalls.

By contrast, on Indicator 11 — which measures whether adult patients were in treatment with ADHD medication within 120 days of starting a care pathway — the same clinic achieved a perfect 20/20 (100%), with a confidence interval of 83–100% [^src3]. The report singles this result out by name, listing PS Almenpsykiatrisk, Syd Ambulatorier in Nordjylland alongside [[pmi-klinik-depression-mani-midt|PMI Klinik for depression og mani – Midt i Midtjylland]] and [[aabenraa-boerne-ungdomspsykiatrisk-ambulatorium|PSY Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium (Aabenraa)]] as the only departments reaching 100% fulfillment [^src1]. This was also the first year this indicator was compiled for adults, following the 2024 expansion of ADHD-databasen to include adult patients, and the report notes wide regional variation nationally — from Region Nordjylland's 85% down to Region Hovedstaden's 37% — again attributed largely to registration difficulties rather than genuine differences in care.

Taken together, the clinic's two scores — 0% and 100% — are not contradictory but reflect two separate, newly introduced quality measures with very small underlying case numbers (20 cases each), making both figures highly sensitive to registration practices. A claim in the report explicitly places the clinic's 100% score at the top end of a departmental range that, among units with more than three patients, ran "Blandt afdelinger med mere end tre patienter fra 21 % på PCK, Psykoterapeutisk klinik i Hovedstaden til 100 % på PS Almenpsykiatrisk, Syd Ambulatorier i Nordjylland, PMI Klinik for depression og mani – Midt i Midtjylland og PSY Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium (Aabenraa)" [^src1].
